newsitem.title: FRANCE: Thomson-CSF to sell Thomainfor - paper.
newsitem.headline: Thomson-CSF to sell Thomainfor - paper.

text.p: Thomson-CSF, the defence electronics arm of the soon-to-be-privatised Thomson Group, has signed a letter of intent to sell its Thomainfor unit to Libra Global Service (LGS) of the United States, the French newspaper Le Monde reported in its weekend edition.
A final agreement is expected in November, it said.
Thomainfor, which specialises in computer maintenance services, had sales of 850 million francs in 1995 and is close to operating break-even, the newspaper said.
The French government is expected to announce the buyer for the Thomson group, which includes consumer electronics concern Thomson Multimedia, by the end of October.
